declarations.description:
A form-associated date-and-time field with a time zone. The value is a wall-clock `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` string (with
`:ss` when `step` is below 60 seconds), the same shape as `<input type="datetime-local">`, read in `time-zone` (an
IANA name such as `Europe/Paris`; empty means the browser's own zone). `valueAsDate` and `valueAsISOString` give
the instant it names, so a meeting at 09:00 in Tokyo stays 09:00 in Tokyo whoever picks it.

The field keeps native keyboard editing. The calendar button (or Alt+ArrowDown in the field) opens a popup with a
month calendar, a `c2-time-input` for the time and, when `time-zones` lists several zones, a time-zone choice;
changing the zone keeps the wall clock. Arrow keys move by day or week in the calendar, Home/End within the week and
Page Up/Page Down by month (with Shift, by year). Days outside `min`/`max` cannot be picked, and the time is clamped
to them. With `time-zone-name`, the zone is submitted alongside the value.
declarations.name: DateTimePicker

cssProperties.description: The zone abbreviation shown in the field.
cssProperties.name: --c2-date-time-picker__time-zone--color

cssProperties.description: The Time and Time zone labels in the popup.
cssProperties.name: --c2-date-time-picker__picker-label--color

slots.description: Replaces the calendar icon at the end of the field.
slots.name: calendar-icon

slots.description: Rich helper content below the field. `help` and `error-text` are plain-text shortcuts.
slots.name: supporting-text

members.name: msg
members.description: Interface text in the nearest `lang`, and that language for `Intl`; a `lang` change redraws.

members.name: field
members.description: Label and description handed down by an enclosing `c2-form-field`, which then draws the supporting line.

members.name: value
members.description: Current wall-clock date and time as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` (or `HH:mm:ss`), read in `time-zone`; empty when unset.

members.name: min
members.description: Earliest valid date and time as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm`.

members.name: max
members.description: Latest valid date and time as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm`.

members.name: step
members.description: Granularity in seconds between valid times, counted from `min`. Below 60 the value carries seconds.

members.name: timeZone
members.description: IANA time zone the value is read in, such as `Europe/Paris`. Empty means the browser's own zone.

members.name: timeZones
members.description: IANA zones the popup offers to choose from, separated by spaces or commas. With fewer than two, the zone is fixed.

members.name: weekStart
members.description: First day of each calendar week.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name of the value.

members.name: timeZoneName
members.description: Form field name under which the time zone is submitted too (the browser's zone when `time-zone` is empty).

members.name: required
members.description: Requires a date and time before the form can be submitted.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Prevents editing while keeping the value in form submission.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Prevents interaction and excludes the value from form submission.

members.name: error
members.description: Applies the visual error state and sets `aria-invalid`.

members.name: help
members.description: Helper text shown below the field.

members.name: errorText
members.description: Message shown below the field while `error` is set.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name forwarded to the native date-time input.

members.name: valueAsDate
members.description: The instant the value names in `time-zone`, or `null` when empty. Setting it writes that instant's wall clock in the zone.

members.name: valueAsISOString
members.description: The value as an ISO 8601 string with the zone's UTC offset (`2026-10-14T09:30:00+02:00`), or empty.

members.name: resolvedTimeZone
members.description: The zone in use: `time-zone` when the engine knows it, else the browser's own zone.

members.name: showPicker
members.description: Opens the popup. Does nothing while disabled or read-only.

members.name: hidePicker
members.description: Closes the popup.

members.name: zoneChoices
members.description: The zones the popup offers, the current one included.

members.name: constrain
members.description: Moves a wall clock onto the `step` grid (counted from `min`, like the native input) and inside `min`/`max`.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired whenever the value or the time zone changes, from typing or from the popup.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when a change is committed: on blur after typing, or on each pick in the popup.
